## Column Page Inset Left Test

This tests the `.column-page-inset-left` class which extends to the left with an inset.

::: {.column-page-inset-left}
PAGE-INSET-LEFT-CONTENT: This content should extend toward the left page edge with a small inset, while keeping the right edge aligned with the body column.
:::

Regular text for comparison.
